title: Submit a deposit request from the cart
description: This test verifies that a customer can complete the deposit request form in the cart and receive submission confirmation.

steps.description: Navigate to /details.html
Add the car for deposit
Click the cart link
Fill in the required deposit request details
Submit the deposit request form
Verify a submission confirmation is visible
Verify the cart submission is completed

title: Add a car for deposit from details
description: This test verifies that a guest can add the selected car for deposit from the details page and see it reflected in the cart.

steps.description: Navigate to /details.html
Add the car for deposit
Click the cart link
Verify the selected car is displayed in the cart
Verify the deposit selection is present

title: Log in and reach the admin dashboard
description: An admin user can sign in with valid credentials and access the administrative dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /login.html
Fill in {{LOGIN_USER}} in the email field
Fill in {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} in the password field
Submit the login form
Verify the admin dashboard is displayed

title: Browse and filter inventory results
description: This test verifies that a guest can open the inventory, narrow the car list with search or filters, and see matching vehicles remain displayed.

steps.description: Navigate to /inventory.html
Scroll to the inventory controls
Fill in a search term that matches a vehicle into the search field
Select a filter value that narrows the inventory
Verify matching vehicles are displayed
Verify the inventory results are narrowed

title: Block access to the admin dashboard without login
description: A guest who tries to open the admin area directly is shown an access control state instead of the dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin.html
Verify access to the admin area is restricted

title: Open a vehicle from inventory
description: This test verifies that a guest can select a car from the inventory list and reach the car details page for that vehicle.

steps.description: Navigate to /inventory.html
Scroll to the car list
Click a vehicle in the inventory list
Verify the car details page is displayed
Verify the selected vehicle details are displayed

title: View car details and image gallery
description: This test verifies that a guest can inspect a car's price, specifications, description, and gallery, and change the main image by selecting a gallery item.

steps.description: Navigate to /details.html
Verify the car price, specifications, and description are displayed
Click a different image in the gallery
Verify the main vehicle image updates

title: Submit a custom car request successfully
description: A guest can submit a custom car request with budget and requirements and see completion feedback.

steps.description: Navigate to /request.html
Fill in a valid budget in the budget field
Fill in vehicle requirements in the requirements field
Submit the custom request form
Verify a request submission confirmation is visible

title: Complete a detailed custom request submission
description: A guest can provide a fuller vehicle brief on the request form and still receive successful completion feedback.

steps.description: Navigate to /request.html
Fill in a valid budget in the budget field
Fill in detailed vehicle requirements in the requirements field
Submit the custom request form
Verify the custom request is submitted successfully

title: Review deposit selections in cart
description: This test verifies that a customer can open the cart and review the cars added for deposit before submitting a request.

steps.description: Navigate to /cart.html
Verify the added cars are displayed in the cart
Verify the deposit request form is displayed

title: Keep request submission usable with a minimum budget and short requirements
description: A guest can submit a concise request using a low but valid budget and brief requirements and still complete the flow.

steps.description: Navigate to /request.html
Fill in a valid minimum budget in the budget field
Fill in brief vehicle requirements in the requirements field
Submit the custom request form
Verify a request submission confirmation is visible

title: Preserve a liked car on revisit
description: This test verifies that a guest can like a car on the details page and see that liked car preserved when returning later.

steps.description: Navigate to /details.html
Add the car to favorites
Navigate to /inventory.html
Click the same vehicle to open its details page again
Verify the car remains marked as liked
Verify the favorite state is preserved

title: Preserve a custom request after returning to the form
description: A guest can enter a request, submit it, and see that the completion state remains visible when revisiting the request area in the same session.

steps.description: Navigate to /request.html
Fill in a valid budget in the budget field
Fill in vehicle requirements in the requirements field
Submit the custom request form
Verify a request submission confirmation is visible

title: Show admin login feedback for invalid credentials
description: A user entering incorrect admin credentials remains on the login flow and sees an invalid login message.

steps.description: Navigate to /login.html
Fill in fake credentials in the email field
Fill in fake credentials in the password field
Submit the login form
Verify invalid login feedback is visible

title: Block unauthorized access to the admin dashboard
description: This test verifies that a guest cannot open the admin dashboard without signing in and is shown an access control response.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin.html
Verify access is restricted
Verify a sign-in prompt or denial message is displayed

title: Reject empty admin login credentials
description: A user cannot submit the admin login form without entering credentials and sees validation feedback.

steps.description: Navigate to /login.html
Submit the login form
Verify a login validation error is visible

title: Reject admin login with incomplete credentials
description: A user cannot reach the admin dashboard when only one login field is filled and sees validation feedback.

steps.description: Navigate to /login.html
Fill in {{LOGIN_USER}} in the email field
Submit the login form
Verify a login validation error is visible

title: Prevent request submission with missing budget
description: A guest cannot complete the custom request flow when the budget is left empty and a validation error is shown.

steps.description: Navigate to /request.html
Fill in vehicle requirements in the requirements field
Submit the custom request form
Verify a budget validation error is visible

title: Stay on the login page after a failed sign in attempt
description: A user who submits invalid admin credentials is not taken to the dashboard and sees login error feedback.

steps.description: Navigate to /login.html
Fill in fake credentials in the email field
Fill in fake credentials in the password field
Submit the login form
Verify the admin dashboard is not displayed
Verify invalid login feedback is visible

title: Prevent request submission with missing requirements
description: A guest cannot complete the custom request flow when requirements are omitted and a validation error is shown.

steps.description: Navigate to /request.html
Fill in a valid budget in the budget field
Submit the custom request form
Verify a requirements validation error is visible
